findings.text: follow-on: commit 3eb7dd05 folds a ruff-format sweep of lines the goal does not touch (machine_map.py:531, 963-966, 1339; the base revision was not ruff-format clean) into the behavioural change, mixing mechanical reflow with the intended change.

follow-on: the clean-venv gate header names revision 3eb7dd05 while the reviewed head is 22e09514; the two differ only by the docs fragment, so the measured code is the head's, but the recorded revision is not the head it is filed under.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit; 3eb7dd05 adds six flat-bundle tests and the single_machine branch in machine_map.py, and 22e09514 adds only the evidence fragment.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done-when is the evidence fence's flat-bundle clause list (refused both/neither, flat paths, store-root resolution, clean venv, test_machine_map.py adds no failures); the gate that asserts it is packages/imas-alambic/tests plus tests/data/test_machine_map.py, both reproduced.
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is imas-ambix:jt60sa-facility-mint section 9, a flat single-machine bundle; machine_map.py:143-156 now branches machine_map_path and signal_map_path on a single_machine flag set at machine_map.py:190 from the machine key present.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records commits 3eb7dd05 and 22e09514, the clean-venv arm (25 passed), the base (29) and head (29) arms of tests/data/test_machine_map.py and the negative control, with log paths and no blockers.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the manifest declares packages/imas-alambic/src/imas_alambic/machine_map.py, packages/imas-alambic/tests/test_flat_bundle.py and docs/evidence/fragments/jt60sa-facility-mint/jtfm-flat-bundles.html; every path in both commits is inside that fence.

justifications.durability: test_flat_bundle.py:166 asserts the flat signal-map path and reddens when the single_machine branch is removed, reproduced by my own mutation (2 failed, EXIT=1); the duplicate-refusal test at test_flat_bundle.py:246 guards only its own supplied value.
justifications.evidence: tests/data/test_machine_map.py base 1926ecb6 (29 passed) and head 22e09514 (29 passed) and packages/imas-alambic/tests at head (25 passed) each reproduced independently under a fresh extraction; blemish: gate-cleanvenv.log:1 names revision 3eb7dd05, not the reviewed head 22e09514.
justifications.fit: machine_map.py:125-142 follows the surrounding dataclass and docstring idiom and adds no name the naming rules forbid; the folded reflow slightly lowers it.
justifications.goal_fidelity: machine_map.py:145-156 branches both path methods on single_machine, set from the key present at machine_map.py:180-190, matching section 9 clause for clause.
justifications.reuse: the flag extends the existing MapBundle owner at machine_map.py:121, and a search of machine_map.py and signal_map.py found no pre-existing flat-bundle addressing to duplicate.
justifications.scope_discipline: only the three declared paths are touched, but commit 3eb7dd05 also reflows unrelated lines at machine_map.py:531, 963-966 and 1339 that the goal does not imply.
